design.name: 炭童
design.brief: A pack-swarming charcoal imp child (炭童), one of the stokers that feed the fire god's furnaces: a small impish kid about 1 m tall whose whole body is built of a few big chunky lumps of matte black charcoal with glowing lava-orange cracks between them, a big round charcoal head with two bright ember eyes and a wide toothy grin, and a little burning ember tuft on the top of its head like a candle wick, glowing yellow-orange (weak spot). It wears only a small frayed vermilion-red Chinese child's bib apron (肚兜) tied with a cord around its neck, and a blackened bronze anklet. Big hands with a clearly separate thumb and four stubby fingers; bare feet with five stubby toes. Cheeky, mischievous and a little creepy.
design.weapon: no weapon: mid-leap, about to hurl a glowing lump of coal broken off its own shoulder
design.style_note: Stylization: cartoon game proportions in the same family as the desert and frost rosters (jerboa soldier, fire rat, sancai tomb beast, golden snub-nosed monkey): chunky simplified masses, oversized heads and hands or paws, toy-like readable forms with clean bevelled edges. Iron, basalt and bronze as a few big faceted plates with sparse painted wear; lava and fire painted as OPAQUE glowing cracks, seams and solid sculpted flame shapes (never transparent fire, smoke or particles); fur, hair and feathers as a few large carved clumps.
design.turnaround_pose: standing upright, feet a little apart, knees slightly bent, arms held a little away from the body in a relaxed A-pose, both hands open and EMPTY (no coal, nothing held); head facing straight ahead with a closed-mouth grin; the ember eyes and the ember tuft on the head painted as opaque bright yellow-orange (no flame, no halo); the cracks between the charcoal lumps painted as opaque glowing orange lines; the red bib apron hanging calmly
design.turnaround_digits: each hand with a separate thumb and four stubby fingers, each bare foot with five stubby toes, clearly countable; the head tuft fully inside the frame.
